entry.title: Awesome Chrome Devtools Updates on Jul 18 - Jul 24, 2022
entry.content:
Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries

  • Playwright (⭐97k) - Cross-browser automation for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit across Node.js, Python, .NET, and Java. See also awesome-playwright (⭐1.6k).

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

  • JavaScript/Node.js: chrome-remote-interface (⭐4.6k) - Low-level CDP client
  • Clojure: cuic (⭐38) - High-level UI test automation

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Browser Adapters

  • Inspect - Use DevTools against iOS and Android browsers and WebViews. (closed source)

Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

  • ruby/debug (⭐1.3k) - Ruby's official debugger, which supports connecting Chrome DevTools over CDP (rdbg --open=chrome).

Alumni / Browser Adapters

  • PuPHPeteer (⭐1.3k) - PHP bridge to Node Puppeteer.
  • Remote Debug Gateway (⭐95) - Connect a debugging client to multiple browsers at once.
    • Multiuser DevTools: DevTools Remote (⭐700) - Remotely debug someone else's browser.
  • DevTools Backend (⭐148) - Standalone implementation of the Chrome DevTools backend to debug arbitrary web environments.
  • Python CDP driver: pychrome (⭐649) - Low-level CDP transport handler.
  • ios-webkit-debug-proxy (⭐6.2k) - Exposes Mobile Safari & UIWebView instances via CDP.
    • Remote Debug iOS WebKit adapter (⭐2.7k) - Builds on ios-webkit-debug-proxy and translates WebKit's Remote Debugging Protocol to CDP.
  • IE Diagnostics Adapter (⭐569) - Protocol adapter translating IE 11 to CDP.

entry.title: Awesome Chrome Devtools Updates on Sep 09 - Sep 15, 2019
entry.content:
Chrome DevTools Protocol

  • ChromeDevTools/devtools-protocol (⭐1.6k) - Canonical location of the protocol JSON, TypeScript types, and issue tracker for protocol bugs.

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Developing with the protocol

  • chrome-remote-interface Wiki (⭐4.6k) - Handy recipes for common raw-CDP tasks.
  • Chrome Protocol Proxy (⭐253) - Proxy for inspecting and debugging CDP client traffic.

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

  • Java: chrome-devtools-java-client (⭐239) - Low-level protocol client
  • Python: PyCDP (⭐147) - Sans-IO wrappers (see also Trio driver (⭐72))
  • Python: ChromeController (⭐229) - High-level browser mgmt
  • Go: chromedp (⭐13k) - High-level actions and tasks
  • Go: cdp (⭐797) - Type-safe bindings for CDP
  • Clojure: clj-chrome-devtools (⭐134) - Autogenerated CDP wrapper

Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

  • VS Code - Elements for Microsoft Edge (⭐829) - Elements and Network panels embedded inside VS Code.

Alumni / Browser Adapters

  • ndb (⭐11k) - Improved Node.js debugging experience built on the DevTools frontend.
  • thetool (⭐223) - CPU, memory, coverage, and type profiling for Node.js.
  • VS Code - Debugger for Chrome (⭐2.2k) - Original Chrome debugger for VS Code (superseded by built-in vscode-js-debug (⭐2k), which has a rich CDP/DAP implementation).
